why_it_matters: Production targets are invalid if horizon basis or sink basis is unclear
required_evidence_or_check: Review packet states whether the target basis is annual horizon-total per-period or other
fail_or_defer_condition: If target basis is unclear or mixed then fail
notes: Production target promotion requires target-basis clarity.

criterion: Validation anchors remain separate from live targets
why_it_matters: Annual public anchors can support plausibility without becoming constraints
required_evidence_or_check: Check that validation-only rows are not reused as live production targets
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms any live target is separately justified
fail_or_defer_condition: If validation anchors are copied into live targets then fail
notes: Validation-only support is not enough for target promotion.

criterion: Annual-to-hourly and configuration applicability are explicit
why_it_matters: Target values can distort feasibility if translation or scope is wrong
required_evidence_or_check: Review packet states translation method and C0/C1 applicability if annual anchors are used
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms translation and applicability are acceptable
fail_or_defer_condition: If translation or applicability is missing then defer
notes: Production targets should be reviewed late in the order.
